BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

A few
questions.

Can I request a one-off job or regular visits?＋

Both can be discussed. Describe the work and say whether you’re looking for a one-off tidy-up or ongoing maintenance.

Can you help with my suburb?＋

Include your suburb or postcode when you call or enquire so coverage can be confirmed before arranging a visit.

What happens to the green waste?＋

Include your green-bin access and any removal needs in the job details. Confirm the waste arrangements as part of the quote.

Does the enquiry form send automatically?＋

No. It prepares an email draft addressed to support@uncledustys.com.au. Review it and send it from your email app, or download a copy. Sending an enquiry does not confirm a booking.
